subject: hooded felt fox

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Make a small fox from dense wool felt, wearing an ochre hood with two ear tips emerging through neat openings. Its paws rest together and its head tilts with quiet curiosity. Use broad cream muzzle pieces and dark embroidered face marks, keeping stitches few and deliberate. Place it on muted blue-gray fabric under soft side light, showing the felt nap without realistic fur or accessories. Square 1024x1024, with a clear central silhouette and no circular border. Original peaceful design, no lettering, logos, or watermark.
